exposure: HCV viremia (detectable viral load during pregnancy)
cohort: The study included 579 pregnant people with singleton gestations and HCV seropositivity, excluding those with HIV co-infection, who had data on breastfeeding initiation.
finding: Rates of breastfeeding initiation were lower among people with HCV viremia compared to those with an undetectable viral load, and people with private insurance were more likely to initiate breastfeeding.
followup_time: 6.0 months (based on the interquartile range maximum for breastfeeding duration)
